meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 它会先判断你的 git 请求属于提交、变基还是查历史,读取仓库最近 30 条提交来识别语言与风格,再把改动拆成多个原子提交(3 个以上文件必须拆成 2 个以上),并执行 fixup、autosquash rebase 等操作。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词,或要查某行改动是谁写的、何时加入时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动拆成原子提交
say.note: 先检测仓库提交风格再分多次提交

say.text: 把这个分支的提交 squash 后变基到 main
say.note: 走变基流程并处理冲突

say.text: 这段代码是谁写的?什么时候加进来的?

howto.what_en: It first classifies your request as commit, rebase or history search, reads the last 30 commits to detect the repo's language and style, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits (3+ files must become 2+ commits).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "commit", "rebase" or "squash", or ask who wrote a change or when it was added.

say_en.text: Commit my changes and split them into atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects style, then makes multiple commits

say_en.text: Squash this branch's commits and rebase onto main
say_en.note: Runs the rebase flow with conflict handling

say_en.text: Who wrote this code, and when was it added?
